digest.component_or_area: LLM runner telemetry and CI/CD integration
propositions: Weekly LLM jobs (external-integration and prompt-eval) make billable calls but surface no retrievable token usage record; usage data is captured in PydanticAIRunner.run as _usage but never reaches CI or is persisted.
A single process-level usage sink at the _usage seam in runner.py can serve both weekly jobs without per-test plumbing by recording to a JSONL file when REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var is set.

The usage_log module must provide record(usage, *, op) for appending JSON lines and summarize(path) for generating Markdown totals plus per-op breakdown, with the summarize function returning 'No LLM calls recorded.' for empty or missing files.

Both weekly job workflows must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG to a temp file path, append summarize output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY with if: always(), and upload the raw JSONL as an artifact for durable post-job retrieval.
Token usage recording is opt-in via REBAR_USAGE_LOG; when unset, record() is a no-op and the runner behavior is unchanged so existing tests and library usage are unaffected.
